```rust
/// Save word-level transcription JSON alongside the audio file.
/// e.g. audio-xxxx.webm → audio-xxxx.transcription.json
pub fn save_word_level_json(audio_path: &Path, json_content: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    ...
    let json_path = audio_path.parent()...join(format!("{}.transcription.json", stem));
    fs::write(&json_path, json_content)...
```
This is called from `mod.rs:831-841` only for `TranscriptionMethod::LocalWhisper`, using the full raw JSON (including per-word timestamps) returned by `transcribe_audio_local_whisper` (`whisper.rs:130,218-228`, comment: "Keep the full JSON (including words) as-is for saving").

**Important:** no frontmatter field points to this `.transcription.json` file — `transcription_id` is only populated for AssemblyAI (`mod.rs:843-848`: `TranscriptionMethod::LocalWhisper { .. } => None`). The JSON file's location is derived purely by naming convention from `recording_audio_path` (swap extension for `.transcription.json`), so consumers must reconstruct the path rather than read it from frontmatter.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reflow transcript note bodies using word-level timing gaps from
`<audio-stem>.transcription.json` files produced by local Whisper.

Usage:
  python3 reflow_transcripts.py <notes_root> [--apply] [--line-gap N] [--para-gap N]

Without --apply, runs in dry-run mode: prints a summary and a few sample diffs,
writes nothing.

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# --- Tunable thresholds (seconds) ---
LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS = 1.0   # gap >= this -> single line break
PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS = 5.0    # gap >= this -> blank-line paragraph break

OPEN_PUNCT = set("([{‘“")
NO_SPACE_BEFORE = set(",.!?;:)]}’”")


def build_text(words):
    parts = []
    prev_end = None
    for w in words:
        token = w["word"].strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if prev_end is None:
            parts.append(token)
        else:
            gap = w["start"] - prev_end
            if gap >= PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS:
                sep = "\n\n"
            elif gap >= LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS:
                sep = "\n"
            elif token[0] in NO_SPACE_BEFORE:
                sep = ""
            elif parts and parts[-1] and parts[-1][-1] in OPEN_PUNCT:
                sep = ""
            else:
                sep = " "
            parts.append(sep)
            parts.append(token)
        prev_end = w["end"]
    return "".join(parts).strip() + "\n"


FRONTMATTER_RE = re.compile(r"^---\r?\n(.*?\r?\n)---\r?\n", re.DOTALL)


def split_note(content):
    m = FRONTMATTER_RE.match(content)
    if not m:
        return None, None
    fm_block = content[: m.end()]
    body = content[m.end() :]
    return fm_block, body


def get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, key):
    m = re.search(rf'^{re.escape(key)}:\s*"?(.*?)"?\s*$', fm_block, re.MULTILINE)
    return m.group(1) if m else None


def normalize_words(text):
    return re.findall(r"\S+", text.strip())


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("notes_root")
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="write changes (default: dry run)")
    ap.add_argument("--line-gap", type=float, default=LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS)
    ap.add_argument("--para-gap", type=float, default=PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS)
    ap.add_argument("--show-diffs", type=int, default=5, help="sample diffs to print in dry run")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    global LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS, PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS
    LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS = args.line_gap
    PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS = args.para_gap

    root = Path(args.notes_root)
    md_files = [p for p in root.rglob("*.md") if not any(part.startswith(".") for part in p.parts)]

    stats = {"completed": 0, "no_json": 0, "mismatch": 0, "unchanged": 0, "to_change": 0}

    mismatches = []

        fm_block, body = split_note(content)

        status = get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, "transcription_status")
        audio_rel = get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, "recording_audio_path")
        if status != "completed" or not audio_rel:

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"WARN: failed to parse {json_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            stats["no_json"] += 1
            continue

        words = data.get("words") or []
        if not words:
            stats["no_json"] += 1
            continue

        current_tokens = normalize_words(body)
        json_tokens = [w["word"].strip() for w in words if w["word"].strip()]
        if current_tokens != json_tokens:
            stats["mismatch"] += 1
            mismatches.append(md)
            continue

        new_body = build_text(words)
        if new_body == body:
            stats["unchanged"] += 1
            continue

        stats["to_change"] += 1
        changes.append((md, body, new_body))

    print("=== Summary ===")
    print(f"Notes with completed transcription_status: {stats['completed']}")
    print(f"  no matching .transcription.json (e.g. AssemblyAI): {stats['no_json']}")
    print(f"  body text no longer matches raw transcript (edited by user, skipped): {stats['mismatch']}")
    print(f"  already formatted / no change needed: {stats['unchanged']}")
    print(f"  will be reflowed: {stats['to_change']}")
    print(f"(thresholds: line-gap={LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS}s, para-gap={PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS}s)")

    if mismatches:
        print("\nSkipped (edited) notes:")
        for p in mismatches[:20]:
            print(f"  - {p.relative_to(root)}")
        if len(mismatches) > 20:
            print(f"  ... and {len(mismatches) - 20} more")

    if not args.apply:
        print(f"\nDry run only. Showing up to {args.show_diffs} sample reflows:\n")
        for md, old_body, new_body in changes[: args.show_diffs]:
            print(f"--- {md.relative_to(root)} ---")
            print("BEFORE:")
            print(old_body.strip()[:300])
            print("AFTER:")
            print(new_body.strip()[:300])
            print()
        print("Re-run with --apply to write these changes.")
        return

    for md, old_body, new_body in changes:
        content = md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        fm_block, _ = split_note(content)
        md.write_text(fm_block + new_body, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nApplied changes to {len(changes)} notes.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reflow transcript note bodies using word-level timing gaps from
`<audio-stem>.transcription.json` files produced by local Whisper.

Usage:
  python3 reflow_transcripts.py <notes_root> [--apply] [--line-gap N] [--para-gap N]

Without --apply, runs in dry-run mode: prints a summary and a few sample diffs,
writes nothing.
"""
import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# --- Tunable thresholds (seconds) ---
LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS = 1.0   # gap >= this -> single line break
PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS = 5.0    # gap >= this -> blank-line paragraph break

OPEN_PUNCT = set("([{‘“")
NO_SPACE_BEFORE = set(",.!?;:)]}’”")


def build_text(words, line_gap, para_gap):
    parts = []
    prev_end = None
    for w in words:
        token = w["word"].strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if prev_end is None:
            parts.append(token)
        else:
            gap = w["start"] - prev_end
            if gap >= para_gap:
                sep = "\n\n"
            elif gap >= line_gap:
                sep = "\n"
            elif token[0] in NO_SPACE_BEFORE:
                sep = ""
            elif parts and parts[-1] and parts[-1][-1] in OPEN_PUNCT:
                sep = ""
            else:
                sep = " "
            parts.append(sep)
            parts.append(token)
        prev_end = w["end"]
    return "".join(parts).strip() + "\n"


FRONTMATTER_RE = re.compile(r"^---\r?\n(.*?\r?\n)---\r?\n", re.DOTALL)


def split_note(content):
    m = FRONTMATTER_RE.match(content)
    if not m:
        return None, None
    fm_block = content[: m.end()]
    body = content[m.end() :]
    return fm_block, body


def get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, key):
    m = re.search(rf'^{re.escape(key)}:\s*"?(.*?)"?\s*$', fm_block, re.MULTILINE)
    return m.group(1) if m else None


def normalize_words(text):
    return re.findall(r"\S+", text.strip())


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("notes_root")
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="write changes (default: dry run)")
    ap.add_argument("--line-gap", type=float, default=LINE_BREAK_GAP_SECONDS)
    ap.add_argument("--para-gap", type=float, default=PARAGRAPH_GAP_SECONDS)
    ap.add_argument("--show-diffs", type=int, default=5, help="sample diffs to print in dry run")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    line_gap = args.line_gap
    para_gap = args.para_gap

    root = Path(args.notes_root)
    md_files = [p for p in root.rglob("*.md") if not any(part.startswith(".") for part in p.parts)]

    stats = {"completed": 0, "no_json": 0, "mismatch": 0, "unchanged": 0, "to_change": 0}
    changes = []  # (path, old_body, new_body)
    mismatches = []

    for md in md_files:
        content = md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        fm_block, body = split_note(content)
        if fm_block is None:
            continue
        status = get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, "transcription_status")
        audio_rel = get_frontmatter_field(fm_block, "recording_audio_path")
        if status != "completed" or not audio_rel:
            continue
        stats["completed"] += 1

        audio_path = root / audio_rel
        json_path = audio_path.with_suffix("").with_suffix("")  # noop safeguard
        json_path = audio_path.parent / (audio_path.stem + ".transcription.json")
        if not json_path.exists():
            stats["no_json"] += 1
            continue

        try:
            data = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"WARN: failed to parse {json_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            stats["no_json"] += 1
            continue

        words = data.get("words") or []
        if not words:
            stats["no_json"] += 1
            continue

        current_tokens = normalize_words(body)
        json_tokens = [w["word"].strip() for w in words if w["word"].strip()]
        if current_tokens != json_tokens:
            stats["mismatch"] += 1
            mismatches.append(md)
            continue

        new_body = build_text(words, line_gap, para_gap)
        if new_body == body:
            stats["unchanged"] += 1
            continue

        stats["to_change"] += 1
        changes.append((md, body, new_body))

    print("=== Summary ===")
    print(f"Notes with completed transcription_status: {stats['completed']}")
    print(f"  no matching .transcription.json (e.g. AssemblyAI): {stats['no_json']}")
    print(f"  body text no longer matches raw transcript (edited by user, skipped): {stats['mismatch']}")
    print(f"  already formatted / no change needed: {stats['unchanged']}")
    print(f"  will be reflowed: {stats['to_change']}")
    print(f"(thresholds: line-gap={line_gap}s, para-gap={para_gap}s)")

    if mismatches:
        print("\nSkipped (edited) notes:")
        for p in mismatches[:20]:
            print(f"  - {p.relative_to(root)}")
        if len(mismatches) > 20:
            print(f"  ... and {len(mismatches) - 20} more")

    if not args.apply:
        print(f"\nDry run only. Showing up to {args.show_diffs} sample reflows:\n")
        for md, old_body, new_body in changes[: args.show_diffs]:
            print(f"--- {md.relative_to(root)} ---")
            print("BEFORE:")
            print(old_body.strip()[:300])
            print("AFTER:")
            print(new_body.strip()[:300])
            print()
        print("Re-run with --apply to write these changes.")
        return

    for md, old_body, new_body in changes:
        content = md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        fm_block, _ = split_note(content)
        md.write_text(fm_block + new_body, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nApplied changes to {len(changes)} notes.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
